Amy wrote down every idea in a small notebook. At first, Amy found it difficult to keep the habit. People around Amy often share different ideas about the night market. An electric vehicle glided past silently.

The night market looked quieter than usual that evening. Amy keeps a small cat at home and feeds it every morning. There are always more possibilities than we expect. The departure board flashed a delay.

They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. Anna advised Amy to try singing as a new hobby. What's more, the bank is in a central location.
Amy's dream job is to be a teacher. Amy believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. What's more, the camping stove simmers porridge fast.
On Thursday evenings, Amy reviews the notes from class. The ticket office has become an important part of daily life. The experience taught Amy more than any book could.
